dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| where event == "FileActivityMessage"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Checkpoint = checkpoint,
    EventDateTime = tostring(['datetime']),
    ExecutionType = toint(case(execution_type == 'Trusted Execution', 0, execution_type == 'Trusted Hash Execution', 0, execution_type == 'Blocked Execution', 1, execution_type == 'Untrusted Execution [Audit]', 2, execution_type == 'Untrusted Execution [OTP]', 3, execution_type == 'Trusted Path Execution', 4, execution_type == 'Trusted Publisher Execution', 5, execution_type == 'Blocklist Execution', 6, execution_type == 'Blocklist Execution [Audit]', 7, execution_type == 'Trusted Process Execution', 8, execution_type == 'Constrained Execution', 9, execution_type == 'Trusted Metadata Execution', 10, execution_type == 'Trusted Browser Execution', 11, execution_type == 'Blocked Browser Execution', 12, execution_type == 'Untrusted Browser Execution [Audit]', 13, execution_type == 'Untrusted Browser Execution [OTP]', 14, execution_type == 'Blocklist Browser Execution [Audit]', 15, execution_type == 'Blocklist Browser Execution', 16, execution_type == 'Trusted Installer Execution', 17, execution_type == 'Trusted Browser Metadata Execution', 18, long(null))),
    ExecutionTypeName = execution_type,
    Username = username,
    Hostname = hostname,
    FileName = filename,
    FilePath = path,
    ParentPolicy = parentgroup,
    PolicyName = ['group'],
    PolicyVersion = policyver,
    PolicyId = policyid,
    CommandLine = commandline,
    Publisher = publisher,
    ParentProcess = parentprocess,
    GrandparentProcess = gparentprocess,
    SHA256 = sha256,
    MD5 = md5,
    SHA128 = sha1,
    IPAddress = ip,
    LocalIPAddress = localip,
    ExtensionId = extid,
    ExtensionName = extname,
    ExtensionType = exttype,
    ExtensionBrowser = extbrowser,
    MetaruleId = metaruleid,
    PackageId = packageid,
    ConnectorName = 'Push'

source
| where event == "ServerActivityMessage"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Checkpoint = checkpoint,
    EventDateTime = tostring(['datetime']),
    Task = task,
    User = ['user'],
    Description = description,
    ConnectorName = 'Push'

source
| where event == "PolicyChangeMessage"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Checkpoint = checkpoint,
    EventDateTime = tostring(['datetime']),
    PolicyGroup = policy_group,
    PolicyVersion = policy_version,
    PolicyId = policy_id,
    User = ['user'],
    Uuid = uuid,
    ChangeDescription = change_description,
    UserReason = user_reason,
    SettingsChanges = settings_changes,
    PublisherChanges = publisher_changes,
    PathChanges = path_changes,
    ParentProcessChanges = parent_process_changes,
    GrandparentProcessChanges = grandparent_process_changes,
    AllowlistChanges = allowlist_changes,
    BaselineChanges = baseline_changes,
    BlocklistChanges = blocklist_changes,
    HashChanges = hash_changes,
    MetaruleChanges = metarule_changes,
    ExtensionChanges = extension_changes,
    ConnectorName = 'Push'
